steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The FIRST attached image is Hỏa Hồ at its ADULT (fully grown) stage: THIS is the character to draw, exactly as it looks there: its head size, neck, shell or body shape, body proportions, face, colours, markings and accessories. The SECOND attached image is the same creature at its smaller CHILD stage and is ONLY a pose and layout guide: four 4x4 blocks, top-left block = facing down (towards the viewer), top-right = facing down-right, bottom-left = facing right, bottom-right = facing up-right; in each block row 1 guard stance x4, row 2 run x4, row 3 attack wind-up / slash / recover / dash, row 4 charge / release / hit / stunned. Draw the ADULT character in every cell, doing the pose of the matching cell of the guide, with the same facing and the same order; do NOT copy the child's proportions, big head or face. The same grid of 8 columns x 8 rows, pixel art with a dark outline, every sprite fully inside its own cell, centred, all at the same size, feet on the same line within a row, sprites not touching. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). Small cells are fine: a clean readable silhouette true to the ADULT matters more than fine detail. Square canvas 1:1.
